questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Cycling around the world
Short, cheap adventures close to home
The most dangerous expeditions ever made
How to plan a long holiday abroad
questions.why: Rob says the topic is 'a new trend for small adventures', shorter breaks closer to home.

options: You don't need to travel far to have an adventure
Big adventures are too expensive
Nobody enjoys walking in the snow
Patagonia is the most beautiful place on Earth
questions.why: He had a hunch 'that you didn't need to go to the ends of the world to have some sort of adventure'.

questions.q: What did Humphreys do to test his idea?
options: He cycled around the world
He camped in Patagonia for a whole month in the winter
He walked around the M25 motorway in the snow
He swam across a river
questions.why: He came up with 'walking a lap of the M25 in the snow in January'.

questions.q: Why did Humphreys choose such a boring, ugly adventure?
options: It was the cheapest option
He had no time for a longer trip because of his work and books
A friend challenged him to do it
To prove even an ugly trip could feel like an adventure
questions.why: He says he decided to try to prove his theory by doing the most boring, ugly adventure he could think of.

questions.q: How did the walk compare with his four years cycling around the world?
options: It felt like the same experience, only smaller
It was much harder and colder than cycling round the world
It was completely boring
It was more beautiful
questions.why: He kept thinking 'this experience is exactly the same', though 'smaller, of course, a bit silly'.

questions.q: What is Neil's opinion of walking beside a motorway?
options: He would love to try it
He thinks it's dangerous
It isn't his idea of adventure
He has already done it
questions.why: Neil says 'walking alongside a motorway isn't my idea of adventure'.

questions.q: What does Humphreys say about spending a night outside?
options: He never feels nervous
It is too cold to enjoy
Feeling a bit nervous is part of the fun
It is only for experienced campers
questions.why: He still imagines ghosts, but says 'that's part of the charm'.

questions.q: What does Rob say would be his biggest fear?
options: Seeing ghosts in the dark at night
Getting back to his desk by 9.00
Jumping in a cold river
Missing the bus home
questions.why: Rob says 'My biggest fear would be returning to my desk for 9.00!'
